claims.claim: Google released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with improved handling of extended multimodal inputs.
claims.episode_span: Google released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a faster, lower-cost model that supports longer video and multimodal clips than the previous Flash generation.
claims.source_title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips

claims.claim: Kakao announced a new decision model that delivers answers in 183 ms on typical requests.
claims.episode_span: Kakao announced a new decision model that delivers answers in 183 ms on typical requests while matching or exceeding several larger models on Decision Index 0.4.1 and Decision Bench v4.
claims.source_title: Kakao releases AI decision model 43 times faster than GPT-6 Luna
claims.supporting_quote: Kakao releases AI decision model 43 times faster than GPT-6 Luna

claims.claim: RecSA scores 60.5 on RULER at 1 M tokens versus 40.0 for the best baseline and accelerates prefill 3.2× and decoding 3.8× at 524 K on one H200 GPU.
claims.episode_span: Initialized from Qwen3-4B and trained on 0.62 B tokens, the method scores 60.5 on RULER at 1 M tokens versus 40.0 for the best baseline and accelerates prefill 3.2× and decoding 3.8× at 524 K on one H200 GPU.
claims.source_title: Recursive Sparse Attention: Million-Token Length Extrapolation at Logarithmic Cost
claims.supporting_quote: At 1M, it scores 60.5, compared with 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA. With our optimized kernels, RecSA is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64K to 2M; at 524K on one H200 GPU, it accelerates prefill by 3.2x and decoding by 3.8x.
